title: Detroit Private Sightseeing Tour with Daily Chauffeur
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Starting from the historical atmosphere of Greenfield Village, we seemed to travel back to the 19th century and feel the charm of that era. The precious artworks of the Detroit Institute of Arts made us linger, and each painting told a unique story. The magnificent architecture and gorgeous decoration of the Fisher Building made us marvel at the architectural art of Detroit. The Henry Ford Museum showcases the brilliant achievements of American industry, where innovation and history are intertwined. Finally, the tranquil greenery of Belle Isle provides a perfect place to relax, and we enjoy the tranquility of nature by the lake.

Recommended route:Detroit Institute of Arts—Fisher Building—Henry Ford Museum of American Innovation—Belle Isle
